turns.instruction:
Build and analyze the two-tier triangular-prism space truss using OpenSees. The equilateral base has side length 4 m: A=(0,0), B=(4,0), C=(2,2*sqrt(3)) in the global XY plane. Levels 0, 1 and 2 have Z=0, 3 and 6 m. Use every node and member endpoint in the attached schedule: six inter-level chords, nine horizontal ties and twelve diagonals. Each side face of each tier has two crossing diagonals with no connection at their crossing. Fix the three base-node translations. All members are axial-only and all joints are pinned; rotational DOFs are inactive and may be numerically suppressed. In load case D, apply global Fx=+10 kN separately at A2, B2 and C2. Report ux, uy and uz at each top node, tension-positive axial forces in every chord and web member (include the horizontal ties), each base node's signed Fx/Fy/Fz reaction, and the signed sum of the three base reactions for each global direction. Use the complete attached node, member, property and load tables. Use first-order linear-elastic static analysis with self-weight, P-Delta, rigid diaphragms and rigid offsets disabled. State the load case, location, component, sign and unit for every result: m for displacements, kN for forces and kN.m for moments. Preserve the actual OpenSees version, runnable input, execution log and raw results, and check global equilibrium.

Execute OpenSees; complete every output in input.md and check equilibrium. Clarify essential gaps or conflicts first.
